pkgmetadata.longdescription:
KiroCrew is a self-hosted, persistent personal AI agent. You chat with it from a web dashboard, the command line, or messaging channels such as Slack and Discord, run multi-step tasks unattended, schedule cron jobs, and it keeps memory across sessions. It drives an agent runtime (kiro-cli) over the Agent Client Protocol.
Upstream is a setuptools project (pip name "kirocrew", import package "kiro_crew") that is not published on PyPI, so this ebuild builds from the GitHub source. The wheel bundles a Vite/React dashboard, which the ebuild compiles with npm at merge time and stages into the package.

use.flag: Enable OTLP/HTTP metrics egress via dev-python/opentelemetry-exporter-otlp-proto-http (export still requires an explicit telemetry endpoint in config)
Install dev-util/py-spy for out-of-process profiling of a running gateway (kirocrew perf sample --pid)
Enable the Microsoft Teams channel (pulls PyJWT with crypto for inbound Bot Framework JWT validation)
Enable the WhatsApp channel via dev-python/neonize (bundles the Go whatsmeow core)
Enable the Feishu (Lark) channel via dev-python/lark-oapi
Enable speech-to-text (local whisper.cpp via pywhispercpp, plus AWS Transcribe via boto3/amazon-transcribe)
